notes.title: Devlog #23 - Sushi Time
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Restaurant Renovators![/h3]

[b][h3]Ready for a new devlog🚨?[/h3][/b]

[h3]It’s time to introduce a brand new location - Sushi Restaurant🍣! Though lack of windows will surely save you some work with removing the boards and cleaning, make no mistake - there is still plenty to do in this charming, cozy spot. Here are some screenshots to prove it.[/h3]

[h3]Here is the front view:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/68734ff31370631be6da57e062e7608a1d0103c3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/187f981aa9d1073f9d979adb32afab026f642883.png[/img]

[h3]And here is the backroom near the staff entrance:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/f0062e05dd7e922c0f5115236960e8a1574890fa.png[/img]

[h3]Last but not least - view of the kitchen:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/53cfc6fea4c8584d4ed0e478b5e166b6f777a2b3.png[/img]

[h3]And let’s not forget about a short clip showing off the new restaurant:[/h3]

[previewyoutube=VO-ct6Rk4ig;full][/previewyoutube] 

[h3]That’s it for now. We hope you liked it and remember to share your opinion on Steam, Discord or here in the comments![/h3]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/jQnsk3AhJ7][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1131517979947978775/1232972545318326302/Discord_banner_4.png?ex=662b66aa&is=662a152a&hm=2fa6d2fecfb5951ba8f98ae6badae381e53c4d934c5c361a845d7d6f30200604&[/img][/url]

[h3]Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlists on Steam to stay in touch with all the latest news from the game! [/h3]

[h3]Best,
Restaurant Renovator Team[/h3]

notes.title: Devlog#19 - New tools & restaurant!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Restaurant Renovators!👩‍🍳[/h3]

Firstly we want to apologize for such a long wait for the updates but now [u][b]WE ARE BACK[/b][/u] with devlogs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/277eb9f9ded045063cec8a64dba5aa7c63c92368.png[/img]

If you've been following the progression of our game development, maybe you remember that last time were working on the procedural visual degeneration of furniture, which we wrote about here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1057630/view/3013462968209703038

Today we want to share with you everything we have been working on since that time.

⭐️[b]New restaurant! High-End 5-Star Hotel Restaurant[/b]
 
[previewyoutube=42dxF5Qa_TE;full][/previewyoutube]


⭐️New tool! [b]Window Squeegee[/b] to make windows squeaky clean!
 
[previewyoutube=KraXrFrcc1c;full][/previewyoutube]


⭐️Another new tool! [b]Box of Pesticides[/b] for all of those pesky rats and cockroaches.
 
[previewyoutube=KbZSsLLRFEc;full][/previewyoutube]


How do you like the work we’ve done?
You can share your opinion on Steam, discord or here in the comments. Remember that your feedback is very important to us. 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/jb7Ejcd5Dz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34967836/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]


[b]Btw. Our Kickstarter is live[/b]. If you still haven't checked our cool pledges, maybe now is the time:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/freemindgames/restaurant-renovator-the-game][img]https://i.imgur.com/5TfnPfm.gif[/img][/url]
